# Adopt Java example

Java Maven-layout tree with a `greet` package and a stdlib-only `solo` package.

```sh
bazel run @rules_dx//:dx -- init //java/tests/fixtures/adopt-java/...
bazel run @rules_dx//:dx -- generate //java/tests/fixtures/adopt-java/...
bazel build //java/tests/fixtures/adopt-java/...
bazel test //java/tests/fixtures/adopt-java/...
```

Both tests pass (`greet_test`, `pure_test`).
